ModMetaData.name: Filter Signals
ModMetaData.author: CoolNether123
ModMetaData.description:
Shows what your colony can actually make, right inside RimWorld's item filters.
- A status square beside each item: producible, unlocked, locked, or unavailable - Click a square to jump to a workstation, research project, or Architect option - Optional filter toolbar, off by default - Changing the view never touches your saved allow and deny choices
Requires Harmony and SpineLib.
